scope: Verify transactional allocation-failure behavior of DRW_Material::encodeDwg for the exact source-derived AC1027 default MATERIAL profile and its selected-object graph replay.

source.producer: Not independently certified by this receipt

implementation.productionChange: DRW_Material::encodeDwg stages every distinct body/string/handle destination, retains intentional stream aliases, checks all staged streams, and publishes with no-throw swaps only after a complete successful encode. Allocation or encoding exceptions return false without changing caller buffers.
implementation.testChange: Direct source-derived record controls inject failure at each reached encoder allocation for five layouts (separate streams, shared strings/handles, body/string alias, body/handles alias, and all aliased). They compare bytes, bit cursors, good state and handle occurrence ledgers before/after failure, then retry the same object against the same buffers and compare with clean output. The existing selected graph sweep injects failure at each reached allocation in the MATERIAL/dictionary callback, verifies destination preservation, retries the same writer, and performs fresh typed readback.

directEncoderAllocationSweep.result: PASS; 318 injected allocation offsets across three physical-source records and five stream layouts; every failed encode preserved caller state and same-object/same-buffer retry matched clean output

selectedGraphAllocationSweep.result: PASS; 295 injected allocation offsets; every failed graph write preserved the seeded destination and same-writer retry passed fresh typed graph readback

physicalSourceSelector.result: PASS; all three records replayed and read back from one generated selected-object graph

validation.fixturePolicy: No DWG/DXF fixtures committed; the physical source is external to the repository and generated outputs are temporary.

limitations: This proves transaction rollback and retry for the selected AC1027 default-material source profile only.
It does not independently validate the physical record field layout or broaden MATERIAL semantic, producer, graph, native-consumer or platform qualification.
The selected graph is not a full-source Cover.dwg rewrite.
